updates.title: Ships are sunk near Hormuz and Brent touches $110 as Iran offers a plan to reopen the strait
updates.summary: Trump holds off on new strikes until after the midterms while Iran and the U.S. disagree on the order of talks.

updates.title: Trump says no Iran strikes before the midterms as fuel prices become a campaign issue
updates.summary: The president pledged not to attack Iran before Nov. 3, while Republicans and Democrats trade blame for high diesel prices.

updates.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu as Iran dares the US to strike again and Qatar plans a defense pact
updates.summary: Trump tied his endorsement to the Iran war nine days before Israel's vote; Iran warns of "unfinished jobs" and oil stays near $98.

updates.title: US and Israel weigh renewed Iran strikes as Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israel's Oct. 27 vote
updates.summary: Hegseth met Netanyahu as both countries weigh a new Iran offensive, and Iran threatened data centers and undersea cables.

updates.title: White House says no Iran attack before the midterms as Iran sets terms for talks
updates.summary: The White House says the US will not attack Iran before Nov. 3, while Trump endorses Netanyahu nine days before Israel's Oct. 27 vote.

updates.title: Iran hardens terms for talks as Trump endorses Netanyahu six days before Israel's election
updates.summary: The White House says no attack before Nov. 3, Iran says no uranium leaves, and Brent crude sits near $109.

updates.title: Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu splits Republicans as Iran restates its red lines
updates.summary: Trump endorsed Netanyahu nine days before Israel's Oct. 27 vote, Vance declined to, and Iran says no enriched uranium will leave.

updates.title: Iran sets red lines as the US says it will not strike before the midterms
updates.summary: Iran says 'not a single gram' of enriched uranium leaves. The White House says the blockade stays and no attack comes before Nov. 3.

updates.title: US and Israel reportedly plan new Iran strikes after the midterms as Hormuz tankers burn
updates.summary: Reports of post-election strike plans pushed Brent to $113 as Iran says seven tankers were hit in the strait.

updates.title: U.S. and Israel reportedly plan new Iran strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Oil jumped on a New York Times report of 'short but intensive' strike plans; Trump says the U.S. is not negotiating.

updates.title: Brent hits its highest settlement since April as U.S. and Israel reportedly plan post-midterm Iran strikes
updates.summary: Brent settled at $116.72 as Houthi attacks on Saudi sites and reports of U.S.-Israeli strike plans fed supply fears; Netanyahu urged toppling Iran's regime.

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. could strike Iran again if there is no deal, as reports point to post-midterm plans
updates.summary: At a Florida rally Trump floated 'another little Operation Epic Fury' unless Iran agrees to a deal, while reports say strike plans are being drafted.

updates.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as reports point to Iran strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: The State Department ordered some embassy staff out of Saudi Arabia while U.S. and Israeli planners reportedly prepare new Iran strikes after Nov. 3.

updates.title: U.S. pulls Saudi staff and weighs Iran strikes after the midterms as Brent nears $116
updates.summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia push oil higher while reports say the U.S. and Israel are planning Iran strikes after Nov. 3; Trump has not approved them.

updates.title: U.S. has plans for major Iran strikes as Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials visit Tehran
updates.summary: CNN reports forces could strike within 96 hours of an order; Trump has not decided, and action is seen as most likely after the Nov. 3 midterms.

updates.title: U.S. has strike plans ready for Iran as regional powers press Tehran for a deal
updates.summary: CNN reports U.S. forces could hit Iran within 96 hours of an order, while Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials meet Iranian leaders in Tehran.

updates.title: U.S. has strike plans ready for Iran as regional powers press Tehran for a deal
updates.summary: Two U.S. officials told CNN forces could strike Iran within 96 hours of an order, as Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials met Iranian leaders.

updates.title: U.S. warns Gulf allies to prepare for a short, intense Iran campaign after the midterms, WSJ reports
updates.summary: Trump would not rule out strikes after Nov. 3, saying 'anything's possible,' while talks and the Hormuz blockade continue.

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran for a deal as reports point to major U.S. strikes after Election Day
updates.summary: The U.S. reportedly told Gulf allies to expect a short, intense campaign after Nov. 3, and the IAEA says it cannot verify Iran's nuclear material.

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran as the U.S. readies a week of strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Qatar leads a uranium-deal push while U.S. and Israeli officials plan heavy strikes after Nov. 3; Iran reportedly rejected the newest proposal.

updates.title: Mediators press Iran on nuclear terms as U.S. plans heavy strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Qatar-led mediators say accepting a package may be Iran's only way to avoid major attacks after Nov. 3.

updates.title: Vance writes to Iran's security chief as U.S. forces prepare for possible strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Vance told Iran any talks must cover its nuclear program, while Trump said "anything's possible" on post-election strikes.

updates.title: Treasury says the Iran blockade has crippled its economy as Trump says Tehran wants to talk
updates.summary: A Treasury assessment says Iran has loaded no oil since Aug. 25, while Trump predicts the war ends 'very soon' and strike options stay ready.

updates.title: Qatari mediators hold marathon Tehran talks as Treasury says the Iran blockade is crippling its economy
updates.summary: Axios reports Qatar is pushing a deal before the midterms while Trump keeps the blockade and military options ready.

updates.title: Qatar presses US and Iran toward talks as Washington warns allies of strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Iran wants the blockade lifted first, the US wants the uranium stockpile, and Trump says he has no hard timetable.

updates.title: Trump says there is no rush to resume Iran strikes as a Qatari draft plan waits for answers
updates.summary: Mediators propose three days of confidence-building steps, and Iran says its two-day Hormuz reopening plan is still unfinished.

updates.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island after Iranian fire at a U.S. aircraft while Trump says there is no rush to resume the war
updates.summary: Officials call the strike defensive, and Qatar waits for answers on a three-day confidence-building plan.

updates.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance says no deadline for a deal
updates.summary: Officials call the strike defensive after Iran fired at a U.S. aircraft, while Trump and Vance keep talking about a settlement.

updates.title: A December Fed rate hike remains the base case as inflation stays at 3.7%
updates.summary: NPR and Fox Business report the Fed held rates on Oct. 28, and traders see about a 75% chance of a hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting.

updates.title: Trump says he would 'do it again' on Iran as Qatari mediators wait for answers
updates.summary: Trump says the war was a factor in the losses but necessary, with no rush to resume strikes.

updates.title: IRGC says tankers burned in Hormuz as Trump defends the Iran war
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the strait, one after hitting an Iranian mine.

updates.title: IRGC says tankers burned in Hormuz as Trump weighs deal or force
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard blamed unauthorized routes for fires on two tankers and a tug, while Trump threatens to 'finish the job' without a nuclear deal.

updates.title: Oil rebounds on Hormuz tanker worries as the Iran war becomes Congress's fight
updates.summary: Brent rose 3.8% to $98.29 after a big drop, while Democrats and Republicans argue over funding and accountability for the war.

updates.title: Oil swings on Iran diplomacy and tanker attacks as Democrats vow to end the war
updates.summary: Brent fell about 14% early in the week, then rebounded to $98.29 Thursday, and Eurasia Group put the odds of renewed US strikes at 60%.

updates.title: Analysts see high risk of renewed US-Iran fighting despite the Democratic sweep
updates.summary: A third US carrier group is headed to the region as oil falls on hopes of diplomacy that analysts doubt.

updates.title: US widens Iran blockade to land routes as Trump weighs a decision on the war
updates.summary: CENTCOM launched a task force to squeeze Iran's land borders, Trump says a war decision is coming, and Vance is pushing a deal.

updates.title: Trump says new Iran strikes are unlikely while talks continue as oil slides
updates.summary: Trump says attacks are "highly unlikely" if talks progress, with Qatar mediating and Brent near $95.

updates.title: Oil drops as Trump calls new Iran strikes unlikely, while Rubio doubts a deal is near
updates.summary: Trump says attacks are "highly unlikely" if Iran signs a strong deal, but Rubio calls some Iranian demands "outrageous."

updates.title: Rubio says an Iran breakthrough is unlikely as Trump signals no new strikes while talks continue
updates.summary: Rubio called some Iranian demands outrageous, while Iran wants sanctions lifted before negotiating and oil prices slid.

updates.title: Rubio says Iran talks are far from a deal as Trump meets Qatar's prime minister
updates.summary: Tehran demands seven conditions and denies talks are happening, while Trump says new strikes are unlikely as long as diplomacy continues.

updates.title: Trump meets Qatar's prime minister, but Rubio says Iran talks are not near a breakthrough
updates.summary: Trump calls new strikes 'quite unlikely' while keeping the blockade, and Washington rejects Iran's 'outrageous' demands.

updates.title: Trump defends the Iran war on Veterans Day as Rubio says the U.S. will hold off on major strikes
updates.summary: Qatar-led mediation continues, Washington calls Iran's demands 'outrageous,' and the blockade stays in place.

updates.title: Iran talks stall as Trump says new strikes are unlikely and Rubio rejects Tehran's terms
updates.summary: Mediators circulate a framework, but Iran's conditions and a U.S. blockade keep the sides apart and Hormuz remains contested.

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. doesn't need a deal with Iran, and oil rises
updates.summary: Trump says he has Iran's Strait and pulls Vance off the talks, while Tehran threatens U.S. and Israeli targets.

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. doesn't need an Iran deal, and Iran rules out nuclear inspections
updates.summary: Oil rose after Trump's post, and Tehran says inspections cannot resume under U.S. threats.

updates.title: Trump keeps the Iran blockade, saying no deal is needed, while Tehran rules out inspections
updates.summary: Trump says the U.S. does not need an Iran deal, Iran refuses nuclear inspections under threat, and oil fell for a second week.

updates.title: Trump says no Iran deal is needed and keeps the blockade, while Tehran rules out inspections
updates.summary: Trump pulled Vance off the Iran talks, Iran says inspections cannot resume under threat, and oil fell for a second week.

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. needs no Iran deal and keeps the blockade, while Iran refuses inspections
updates.summary: Mediators' proposals sit unaccepted, the blockade stays, and the IAEA still cannot inspect Iran's Isfahan site.

updates.title: Iran fires drones at a U.S. base in Bahrain as Trump keeps the blockade and says no deal is needed
updates.summary: The U.S. says it stopped two drones with no damage, while Trump's strategy is to wait and keep the pressure on.

updates.title: Iran keeps up drone attacks on Bahrain, a CNN report cites a possible dirty-bomb plot, and Trump says no deal is needed
updates.summary: The U.S. says it stopped the drones, the White House sees no credible homeland threat, and Trump keeps the blockade.

updates.title: Iran fires drones at a U.S. radar site in Bahrain for the third time in five days
updates.summary: CENTCOM says the drones were intercepted without damage, while Trump calls the war effectively over and keeps the blockade.

updates.title: California officials vow to fight the Justice Department's suit over ballots for alleged noncitizens
updates.summary: Secretary of State Weber and Attorney General Bonta refuse to withhold ballots for about 20,000 flagged voters, and experts call the suit a long shot.

updates.title: Forecasters favor Democrats for the House and see a toss-up Senate with 16 days to go
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and The Hill all show Democrats ahead in House ratings; Speaker Johnson predicts Republicans will hold on.

updates.title: Trump rallies in Kansas as a deep-red Senate seat becomes competitive
updates.summary: Trump campaigned for Sen. Roger Marshall near Wichita, said the polls are fake, and starts a week of travel to Senate battlegrounds.

updates.title: Trump rallies for Sen. Marshall in Kansas as Republicans defend a long-safe seat two weeks before Election Day
updates.summary: Trump held a Kansas rally for Sen. Roger Marshall, whose race against Democrat Adam Hamilton is rated competitive.

updates.title: Cook shifts three Senate races as Trump's approval hits a record low in one poll
updates.summary: Cook moved South Carolina and Mississippi toward Democrats and Minnesota toward Republicans, while Trump campaigns in red states with two weeks to go.

updates.title: Trump's approval hits a record low in Reuters/Ipsos as Kansas holds its final Senate debate tonight
updates.summary: Reuters/Ipsos has Trump at 31%, Cook shifted three Senate races, and Marshall and Hamilton debate tonight in a toss-up Kansas race.

updates.title: Trump uses the word 'Shylock' at a Kansas rally while defending Sen. Marshall's medical-debt lawsuits
updates.summary: CNN, The Hill and the Washington Examiner report the remark, and CNN's fact check finds no law required Marshall to sue patients.

updates.title: Marshall and Hamilton clash in a fiery final debate as the Kansas Senate race tightens
updates.summary: Both candidates tried to distance themselves from their national parties, while Marshall's medical-debt past and Hamilton's church-camp response drew questions.

updates.title: Two weeks out, polls favor Democrats nationally while the Senate stays contested
updates.summary: Fox's poll has Trump at a record-low 36 percent and Democrats up nine on the House ballot, while analysts see a tight Senate.

updates.title: Polls show Democrats ahead for the Nov. 3 midterms
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and NPR polls all put Democrats ahead on the House ballot and Trump's approval near record lows.

updates.title: Polls show Democrats ahead for the Nov. 3 midterms
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and NPR polls all put Democrats ahead on the House ballot and Trump's approval near record lows.

updates.title: Early voting passes 20 million ballots as both parties argue over what it means
updates.summary: Democrats lead early returns in most states with data, but analysts and Republicans say Election Day turnout will decide it.

updates.title: Early voting runs far ahead of 2022 as Democrats lead where party data exists
updates.summary: Totals differ by tracker, but turnout is up sharply in Texas, Kansas and North Carolina with nine days to go.

updates.title: Early voting runs far ahead of 2022 and Democrats look competitive in Texas, Kansas and Ohio
updates.summary: About 29 million early ballots are in, and Democrats need a net four Senate seats; Fox News has Texas tied at 49%.

updates.title: Trump rallies in Michigan and Mississippi as the Texas Senate race stays tied
updates.summary: With eight days to go, Trump is defending a deep-red Mississippi seat while a Fox News poll has Texas tied at 49% and Michigan near even.

updates.title: Trump heads to Texas as Fox poll has Senate race tied and Michigan stays a toss-up
updates.summary: A Fox News poll has Paxton and Talarico tied at 49%, and Trump campaigns in Waco and Lubbock today.

updates.title: Texas Senate race is tied in the last week as Trump rallies and Michigan stays close
updates.summary: Trump rallies in Texas as a Fox poll has Paxton and Talarico tied at 49%, and Michigan polls split.

updates.title: Senate control runs through Texas, Michigan and Ohio, with polls inside the margin of error
updates.summary: Recent polls show Talarico, El-Sayed and Brown narrowly ahead in Texas, Michigan and Ohio, and Trump is back in Ohio.

updates.title: Democrats lead the generic ballot by about 9 points as Trump and Obama make closing pitches
updates.summary: Polls favor Democrats for the House and keep the Senate close, while Trump rallies in Texas and Ohio and Obama campaigns in Ohio and Michigan.

updates.title: Democrats hold a steady lead in the final week as Trump campaigns in red states
updates.summary: CNN's average has Democrats up about 9 points on the generic ballot; Trump campaigned in Texas, where a Fox poll shows a tie.

updates.title: Democrats lead national polls and Senate odds improve as the midterms near
updates.summary: A Marist poll shows Democrats up 8 points nationally, and new CNN polls show them competitive in Michigan, Texas, Maine and Kansas.

updates.title: Democrats look strong for the House and competitive for the Senate five days before the midterms
updates.summary: New CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan and Texas, and forecasters give them about an 80% shot at the House.

updates.title: Trump reverses his rally cancellations as Democrats lead several Senate polls four days before the midterms
updates.summary: Trump will hold in-person rallies in Iowa and Kansas on Sunday after canceling them, while CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan, Texas and Kansas.

updates.title: Alaska Senate race is roiled by a report that Democratic operatives backed a second Dan Sullivan
updates.summary: A New York Times report alleges Peltola campaign and DSCC staff helped field a second candidate named Dan Sullivan, which both deny.

updates.title: Trump revives Iowa and Kansas rallies as CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan and Texas
updates.summary: After canceling and then restoring two red-state rallies, Trump will appear in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday while Senate polling tightens.

updates.title: Trump closes the midterm campaign in Iowa and Kansas as control of Congress hangs on toss-up Senate races
updates.summary: Trump holds rallies in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday after cancelling and then reinstating them, with two days to go.

updates.title: Voters decide control of Congress on Tuesday, with Democrats favored in the House and the Senate a toss-up
updates.summary: Forecasters give Democrats a strong edge in the House, while the Senate hinges on Alaska, Iowa, Maine, South Carolina, Texas and Michigan.

updates.title: Voters decide control of Congress as polls open, with Democrats favored in the House and the Senate in play
updates.summary: Democrats need three House seats and lead CNN's generic-ballot average by 9 points, while Fox rates the Senate a toss-up.

updates.title: Judge tosses Justice Department Alaska ballot suit as Trump hedges on accepting results and DOJ sends record monitors
updates.summary: The department will appeal the Alaska ruling to the 9th Circuit, and about 1,000 monitors are deployed in all 50 states.

updates.title: Polls close across the country with control of Congress undecided
updates.summary: Control of the House and Senate is at stake tonight, and NPR warns the Senate call could take much longer than the House.

updates.title: House Democrats weigh investigations first and impeachment later
updates.summary: Jeffries has not ruled impeachment in or out, and reporters say probes of Trump's businesses and immigration enforcement come first.

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump calls that largely true
updates.summary: Vice President Vance blamed the Iran war for the GOP rout, and Trump said it was largely true but that he would do it again.

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump partly agrees
updates.summary: Vice President Vance blamed the Iran war for the GOP rout, while Trump said Iran was part of it but defended the war.

updates.title: Democrats hold 54 Senate seats in NBC's count as Mississippi hangs on a few dozen votes
updates.summary: Democrats swept Congress, but the Mississippi Senate race is separated by dozens of votes and the state has no recount process.

updates.title: Conservative writers blame Trump, the Iran war and affordability for the Republican rout
updates.summary: National Review, the Free Press and the Washington Examiner give competing explanations for the GOP's midterm losses.

updates.title: Democrats plan oversight blitz and Trump promises vetoes
updates.summary: Incoming committee chairs target Trump family business, immigration enforcement and the Iran war, while Trump says he will become 'Mr. Veto'.

updates.title: Mississippi Senate race stays too close to call with mail ballots due Tuesday and no recount process
updates.summary: Democrat Scott Colom leads Sen. Hyde-Smith by about 1,800 votes while both parties prepare for a fight over provisional ballots.

updates.title: Democrats win both chambers and set an agenda of health care, tariffs and ending the Iran war
updates.summary: NBC projects about 255 House seats for Democrats, and Jeffries names four priorities while Trump promises vetoes.

updates.title: Vance blames the Iran war for the Republican rout, while Toomey, Cruz and conservative writers cite tariffs
updates.summary: Trump partly agrees with Vance's war diagnosis, and right-leaning outlets split over tariffs, the war and Trump's treatment of Congress.

updates.title: Mississippi's Senate race stays too close to call as provisional and late mail ballots are counted
updates.summary: Democrat Scott Colom leads Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by roughly 2,500 votes in CNN's count, with provisional ballots and lawyers on both sides.

updates.title: Republicans argue over whether the Iran war or tariffs sank them in the midterms
updates.summary: NBC projects Democrats won both chambers, and conservatives are split between blaming the Iran war, tariffs and corruption.

updates.title: Democrats plan investigations and an affordability agenda, but face Trump's veto
updates.summary: Democrats won both chambers and plan oversight, ACA and tariff votes, while conservatives argue over how much the economy and Iran cost Republicans.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline and a stalled GOP agenda
updates.summary: Congress has about five weeks to avoid a shutdown, and aides expect a stopgap through March or April.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline, the defense bill and a nominee rush
updates.summary: Lawmakers returned with five weeks to avoid a shutdown, and a short-term extension looks most likely.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces Dec. 11 funding deadline as House GOP leadership scrambles
updates.summary: Republicans still run Congress until January, with a funding deadline, the defense bill and a farm bill ahead and Speaker Johnson's future unsettled.

updates.title: Lame-duck Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline and a crowded agenda
updates.summary: Republicans return after their midterm losses with a stopgap expiring Dec. 11, a defense bill and judicial nominees to clear before Democrats take over.

updates.title: Thune keeps Senate GOP leadership as Congress faces a Dec. 11 funding deadline
updates.summary: Republicans re-elected Thune after a failed delay push, with a short-term spending bill widely expected before Democrats take over.

updates.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins the Mississippi Senate seat, lifting Democrats to at least 55 seats
updates.summary: Colom beat Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by a few thousand votes, and Republicans are now arguing over who is to blame for the losses.

updates.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat as Alaska stays uncalled
updates.summary: Colom beat Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by under 5,000 votes, lifting Democrats to at least 55 seats, while Republicans argue over who lost the midterms.

updates.title: White House warns House Democrats that aggressive probes could be criminal
updates.summary: White House counsel Will Scharf told the incoming Oversight chair that subpoenas meant to intimidate may cross into criminality, and Democrats say they will not be deterred.

updates.title: White House says Democratic probes could become criminal, and Garcia says he won't back down
updates.summary: A White House counsel letter warns incoming House Democrats, who cite Article I and name Kushner's Saudi deal as a first target.

updates.title: Peltola holds a narrow lead in the uncalled Alaska Senate race
updates.summary: Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan by about 4,000 votes, and ranked-choice tabulation may decide it.

updates.title: Peltola keeps a lead in the uncalled Alaska Senate race as counting continues
updates.summary: Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan by several thousand first-choice votes, but ranked-choice rounds may decide it.

updates.title: Peltola keeps her lead in the uncalled Alaska Senate race as ranked-choice count nears
updates.summary: Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan, but she is under 50% of first-choice votes, so ranked-choice rounds on Nov. 18 may decide it.

updates.title: Peltola keeps her lead in Alaska's uncalled Senate race as the ranked-choice count nears
updates.summary: Alaska's official ranked-choice tabulation is set for Nov. 18, and analysts disagree on how transfers will break.

updates.title: Trump's lame-duck agenda stalls as Miller takes over the White House and Republicans trade blame
updates.summary: After the midterm losses, Stephen Miller replaced Susie Wiles, a Hegseth impeachment bid failed 211-204, and conservative writers blame Trump's treatment of Congress.

updates.title: Why California's billionaire tax could fail even if more than half of voters back it
updates.summary: Props. 41 and 42 are written to cancel Prop. 40 if they outpoll it, and the latest public poll shows a close race.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and Newsom backs a measure to cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 polls near 50%, and Prop. 42 would void it if it gets more votes.

updates.title: Newsom endorses Prop. 42, a ban on wealth taxes that would cancel the billionaire tax
updates.summary: Newsom opposes Prop. 40 and backs Prop. 42, splitting from the state Democratic Party and labor groups that endorse the billionaire tax.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a slim poll lead, but two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: A September PPIC poll had Prop. 40 at 52 percent to 46 percent, and Newsom backs Prop. 42, which would ban new wealth taxes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a slim poll lead, but two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 leads narrowly, while Props. 41 and 42, backed by tech billionaires, could void it if either gets more yes votes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 would levy a one-time 5% tax on billionaires, but Props. 41 or 42 void it if either gets more yes votes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop 40 polls from slightly ahead to slightly behind, and Props 41 and 42 could block it even if it passes.

updates.title: New PPIC poll puts California's billionaire tax behind, 46% to 52%
updates.summary: Prop. 40 slipped from a lead to a deficit, and a rival measure can cancel it even if it wins a majority.

updates.title: Prop 40 opponents outspend backers about three to one as the billionaire tax trails in polls
updates.summary: CalMatters' voter guide counts $99.8 million raised against the tax and $31.7 million for it, and Newsom backs a rival measure.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax falls behind in a new PPIC poll days before the vote
updates.summary: The Public Policy Institute poll has 46% of likely voters for the one-time wealth tax and 52% against, a reversal from September.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax falls behind days before California votes
updates.summary: A PPIC poll shows 46% yes and 52% no among likely voters, a swing from September's 52% majority.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax trails in two polls as opponents outspend backers more than six to one
updates.summary: PPIC has 46% for and 52% against, and Berkeley IGS has 42% for and 50% against, with Props 41 and 42 designed to cancel it.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax trails in two polls as opponents outspend backers more than six to one
updates.summary: PPIC has 46% for and 52% against, Berkeley IGS has 42% for and 50% against, and Props 41 and 42 would cancel the tax if they win more votes.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax loses its poll lead as Stanford economists warn of a multibillion-dollar revenue hole
updates.summary: PPIC has the tax at 46% yes and 52% no, and two countermeasures could cancel it even if it passes.

updates.title: California's Prop 40 billionaire tax heads to Tuesday's vote trailing in polls, with two countermeasures that could cancel it
updates.summary: PPIC has the tax at 46% yes and 52% no, and UC Berkeley's IGS poll shows it down 42% to 50%.

updates.title: California votes on the Prop 40 billionaire tax, which trails in polls and faces two countermeasures
updates.summary: PPIC's late-October poll has the tax at 46% yes and 52% no, and Props 41 and 42 could cancel it even if it passes.

updates.title: California votes on the Prop 40 billionaire tax, which trails in polls and can be erased by Props 41 or 42
updates.summary: A late PPIC poll had Prop 40 at 46% yes and 52% no, and either countermeasure could cancel it even if it passes.

updates.title: Californians vote on the Prop 40 billionaire tax, which polls showed trailing and which Props 41 and 42 can cancel
updates.summary: A late PPIC poll had Prop 40 at 46% yes and 52% no, and either Prop 41 or 42 can erase it even if it passes.

updates.title: California's Prop 40 billionaire tax is failing while Prop 42 leads
updates.summary: Early returns show Prop 40 with about 56% no votes, and its counter-measure Prop 42 ahead at about 55%.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax appears headed for defeat as Prop 42 leads
updates.summary: The AP showed about 56% voting no on Prop 40 with over half counted, and Prop 42 leading at about 55%.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax appears headed for defeat while Prop 42 leads
updates.summary: Early counts show about 55% voting no on the one-time 5% billionaire tax, and the union behind it says it may return in 2028.

updates.title: Prop 40 billionaire tax appears headed for defeat while Prop 42 leads, and Becerra wins governor
updates.summary: Early returns have Prop 40 near 55% no and Prop 42 ahead, and Xavier Becerra will succeed Newsom.

updates.title: California voters reject the billionaire tax, and Prop 42 looks set to block future wealth taxes
updates.summary: Prop 40 failed 52.8% to 47.2% after opponents spent heavily, and SEIU-UHW says it will try again in 2028.

updates.title: Trump and Zelensky clash over refinery strikes as Ukraine runs out of Patriot missiles
updates.summary: Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian refineries, Trump criticized Zelensky, and CNN reports no Patriot interceptors are left.

updates.title: Zelensky accuses Trump of pushing Ukraine to yield as the Starshield dispute continues
updates.summary: After Ukraine hit a Russian oil terminal, Trump said Zelensky never wanted peace; Zelensky says Washington is pressing Kyiv to capitulate.

updates.title: Trump says it is time for someone else to negotiate for Ukraine after a major drone attack
updates.summary: Ukraine's weekend drone attack on a St. Petersburg oil terminal deepened its rift with Washington, and Senate Republicans urge a deal on energy strikes.

updates.title: Putin agrees in principle to resume three-way talks as Russia pounds Kyiv
updates.summary: Kremlin aide says talks could come around Nov. 10, and Russia freed an American prisoner.

updates.title: Putin agrees in principle to resume three-way Ukraine talks after Nov. 10
updates.summary: Witkoff met Putin Oct. 21 and Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard; Kyiv was struck hours later.

updates.title: Putin agrees in principle to resume three-way Ukraine talks after Nov. 10
updates.summary: Witkoff met Putin Oct. 21 and Russia freed American Stephen Hubbard; Kyiv was struck hours later.

updates.title: Trump's Russia diesel deal and sanctions waiver strain ties with Ukraine and Republican hawks
updates.summary: Washington eased some Russia penalties to lower fuel prices, drawing criticism from Zelensky and some Republicans.

updates.title: Melania Trump brokers a one-city ceasefire in southern Ukraine as the Trump-Zelensky rift lingers

updates.title: Democrats call for a national data center moratorium as Republicans split
updates.summary: Sanders and other top Democrats seized on 40 of 41 local ballot wins, while some Republicans back pauses of their own.

updates.title: Voters reject data centers at the ballot box and industry rewrites its pitch
updates.summary: Nearly every local data center ballot measure went against developers, and OpenAI pledged to end NDAs with officials and pay for power.

updates.title: Hawley's data center moratorium call exposes a split in the GOP
updates.summary: Sen. Josh Hawley became the first Republican senator to back a national data center moratorium as Heritage says the party misread voters.

updates.title: Nvidia falls 4.3% as its board probes Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy
updates.summary: An independent committee will investigate, and House chairs want Huang to brief them Nov. 18, a day after earnings.

updates.title: Nvidia slides 4.3% as its board investigates CEO Jensen Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy
updates.summary: Shares edged up premarket Tuesday, while analysts weigh leadership and China risk before earnings on Nov. 17.

updates.title: Congress presses Nvidia on China chip sales as Huang is asked to brief lawmakers Nov. 18
updates.summary: Three House Republican chairs want Jensen Huang to explain his ties to a Megaspeed executive, and Democrats promise their own oversight.

updates.title: Congress presses Nvidia's Huang over alleged Chinese spy ties as Trump defends him
updates.summary: House chairs want a closed-door briefing Nov. 18, Democrats call Trump's support a failure of duty, and Nvidia's board is investigating.

updates.title: Nvidia's Huang has not committed to a House briefing as his board investigates ties to an alleged Chinese spy
updates.summary: Three House chairs want a closed-door briefing Nov. 18, one floated a subpoena, and Trump publicly defends Huang.

updates.title: Huang scandal revives push to tighten Nvidia chip sales to China
updates.summary: Lawmakers in both parties want chip export limits added to the defense bill after reports that an alleged Chinese spy helped move at least $7.5 billion of Nvidia chips.

updates.title: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia as CEO, and the stock slides before earnings
updates.summary: Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after reports of two affairs, and shares fell about 9% before Thursday's open.

updates.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, and the stock falls ahead of Tuesday's earnings
updates.summary: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, Harvey Jones is chairman, and Nvidia closed down more than 4% after a deeper early slide.

updates.title: Nvidia edges higher premarket after Huang's exit, with earnings due Tuesday
updates.summary: Kress is interim CEO, Nvidia fell 4.3% Thursday, and some staff want Huang back.

updates.title: Nvidia slides again after Huang's exit, with earnings due Tuesday
updates.summary: Nvidia fell 2.0% Friday and dropped below a $4 trillion market value as its board searches for a CEO before Tuesday's earnings.

updates.title: Nvidia slides again after Huang's exit, with earnings due Tuesday
updates.summary: Nvidia fell 2.0% Friday after a roughly 13% weekly drop as its board searches for a CEO before Tuesday's report.

updates.title: Nvidia reports Tuesday after a sixth straight weekly loss and without Jensen Huang
updates.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress faces her first call, with analysts expecting about $108.9 billion in revenue.

updates.title: Nvidia reports Tuesday for the first time without Jensen Huang as Washington fights over China chips
updates.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress faces questions on China and Southeast Asia sales, and Bessent and Lutnick are in an open dispute.

updates.title: Nvidia reports Tuesday without Jensen Huang after another 4% drop, as Washington fights over China chips
updates.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress faces questions on China and Southeast Asia sales while Bessent and Lutnick dispute who delayed action on Megaspeed.

updates.title: Nvidia reports after the close tonight, its first quarter since Jensen Huang's exit
updates.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress faces questions on the CEO transition and China sales, with analysts expecting about $109 billion in revenue.

updates.title: Sanders and Slotkin won't back Schumer, and Van Hollen weighs a challenge
updates.summary: Schumer vows to run for leader anyway, and the caucus votes in early December.

updates.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
updates.summary: Chris Van Hollen says he will run against Chuck Schumer, and the secret-ballot vote is set for Dec. 1.

updates.title: Van Hollen formally challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
updates.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen launched a bid against Chuck Schumer, calling himself the underdog, as more Democrats decline to back the current leader.

updates.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
updates.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will run against Chuck Schumer in the first contested Senate Democratic leadership race since 1994.

updates.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader
updates.summary: The first contested Senate Democratic leadership race since 1994 will be settled by secret ballot on Dec. 1.

updates.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader as vote counts conflict
updates.summary: Schumer says he has the votes, Van Hollen calls himself an underdog, and public tallies disagree before the early December secret ballot.

updates.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate Democratic leader as vote counts conflict
updates.summary: Schumer says he has the votes, Van Hollen calls himself an underdog, and public tallies disagree before the early December secret ballot.

updates.title: Schumer looks like the favorite as Van Hollen's challenge for Democratic leader begins
updates.summary: Van Hollen says he has 15 votes, while Schumer counts at least 15 public endorsements and says he has the votes to keep his job.

updates.title: SpaceX preps Starship Flight 15 and plans to try catching both stages
updates.summary: Flight 15 is planned to attempt the first catch of both stages.

updates.title: SpaceX plans the first attempt to catch both Starship stages at the tower
updates.summary: SpaceX plans the first booster-and-ship catch attempt.

updates.title: SpaceX targets Friday for the first attempt to catch both Starship stages
updates.summary: Flight 15 is targeted for Friday, Nov. 13.

updates.title: SpaceX targets Friday for Starship Flight 15, the first attempt to catch both stages
updates.summary: The launch is targeted for 2:45 p.m. Pacific Friday.

updates.title: SpaceX targets today for Starship Flight 15, the first attempt to catch both stages
updates.summary: The launch window opens at 2:45 p.m. Pacific, and the ship catch would come about 22 hours later.

updates.title: Starship Flight 15 reaches orbit, but SpaceX calls off the booster catch
updates.summary: The ship is in orbit for a planned Saturday landing, while the Super Heavy booster splashed down in the Gulf.

updates.title: Starship Flight 15 reaches orbit after SpaceX aborts the booster catch
updates.summary: The ship is in orbit for a planned Saturday tower catch, while the Super Heavy booster splashed down in the Gulf.

updates.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage after orbit for the first time
updates.summary: The ship returned about 22.5 hours after liftoff and landed in the tower's arms, but the booster catch was aborted.

updates.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage after 14 orbits, but loses the booster catch
updates.summary: Ship 42 returned to the tower after about 22.5 hours; the booster aborted after a low-fuel alarm.

updates.title: SpaceX catches a Starship upper stage after 14 orbits, but the booster catch fails over a low-fuel alarm
updates.summary: Ship 42 returned to the tower after about 22.5 hours; SpaceX is still digging into why the booster aborted.

updates.title: SpaceX is still working out why the Starship booster skipped its tower catch
updates.summary: Two explanations are on the table, a low-fuel alarm and an automated positioning abort, after the ship was caught by the tower.

updates.title: Duffy asks Congress for $50 billion after the FAA ground stop, and Democrats say the money already exists
updates.summary: The transportation secretary wants a replacement telecom network funded, while Democrats say only about a third of last year's $12.5 billion has been spent.

updates.title: Duffy asks Congress for $50 billion after the FAA ground stop, and Democrats say the money already exists
updates.summary: The transportation secretary wants a replacement telecom network funded, while Democrats say only about a third of last year's $12.5 billion has been spent.

updates.title: FAA outage traced to a router after a copper-to-fiber upgrade, but root cause is unresolved
updates.summary: Duffy blames a contractor's upgrade at a remote site, while others point to aging systems, and a removed router is being inspected.

updates.title: Army major files whistleblower complaint over the Kuwait drone strike that killed six, and Trump attacks 60 Minutes
updates.summary: Maj. Stephen Ramsbottom says warnings went unheeded before the March 1 strike, while Trump says only two of 8,000 to 9,000 drones caused U.S. deaths.
